row.body: on the back: “saturday before sunrise, waxy pollen in the weathered bundle after the fertilizer trial. our cat hid from the water bowl. later, traffic was turned around.”
row.title: weathered bundle note — saturday before sunrise

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the waxy pollen while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
